== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Snowspeeder (Japanese)|Snowspeeder]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/148375113/OEmB1Bxvq0mGEaQkAgA0SA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 82917286.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b35a5ff09e0e5cd504a96c6fd79f79c507c21cf19b2f71838114d5b4257869a3</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
